title: The Ground of Other Decisions

features.name: bifurcation-chip
features.desc-on-touch: A processor where every decision branches into two equal paths. Both paths remain active here; neither was chosen, so both weigh the same.

features.name: trace-path
features.desc-on-touch: Electrical traces that fork and fork again. You follow one until it doubles back to meet the one you didn't choose, and they acknowledge each other.

features.name: decision-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Its surface reflects not what is above but what could have been. Each reflection is equal in depth and clarity to the path you actually took.

features.name: alternative-tower
features.desc-on-touch: A tower built from stacked possibilities, each layer a different version of what you might have chosen. Climb it and each level shows a slightly different sky.

features.name: echo-sprite
features.desc-on-touch: A shape that might be you if you had turned left instead of right. It moves at the same speed you do but in a direction perpendicular to your own path.

features.name: junction-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A symbol for crossroads. The more closely you examine it, the more arms it seems to have, reaching in directions that don't exist on any map.

inscription: here every circuit traces a path you didn't take; the ground holds them all equally, and they are heavier than the path you chose
